text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein chairs meeting of the Revolutionary Command Council and leaders of the ruling Baath party.
- Saddam meets defence minister and senior officers from the air defence units.
- Russia does not recognise air-exclusion zones.
- France tells United States that implementation of oil-for- food deal with U.N. is necessary.
- Washington warns citizens in Saudi Arabia.
- Cuba, Yemen, Malysia, Tunisia and Vietnam denounce U.S. aggression.
- Angry demonstrations sweep Pakistan and Bangladesh denouncing U.S. missile strikes on Iraq.
- National Assembly speaker calls on world parliaments to denounce aggression.
- Aglo-American draft resolution faces tough resistance at U.N. Security Council.
(The above were also carried by al-Iraq)
- Commentaries ridicule President Bill Clinton for saying the U.S. completed its mission in Iraq.
